text: What if you woke up in East Berlin, November nineteen eighty nine, with your phone in your pocket?
No signal. No wifi. Thirty one percent battery. Your phone is now the most advanced object in the country.
People on the tram stare at the glowing glass in your hand. A man asks if it's from the West. You say: kind of.
You remember history class. You tell your neighbor the Wall opens tonight. He laughs and closes the door.
A press conference on TV. A politician reads a note about new travel rules. Someone asks when. He says: immediately.
At a border crossing, thousands of people are waiting. Then the barrier goes up.
You film everything. The hugs. The tears. Strangers pouring champagne on the street.
You have the only four k video of the night the Wall fell. And the next charger for your phone won't exist for twenty five years.
Your screen goes black. Nobody will ever believe you.
What would you film first? Tell me in the comments.
